svg.title: Red White
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Tate Liverpool authored 2017 announcement GIF frame 2 supplies actual red/white painting. Two bulbous red forms touch right edge and meet at central leftward cusp; white upper/lower-right regions retained. Overall support 165.4 x 229.5 cm verified in Tate 2014–15 full annual report PDF page 72, accession T 14156.
